stories.headline: Russia deploys rare hypersonic missile in one of war's largest attacks on Kyiv During the attacks, Moscow used a rare nuclear-capable ballistic missile – dubbed Oreshnik – which it has said cannot be intercepted.
stories.summary: Russia has launched a massive attack on Kyiv, using a rare nuclear-capable ballistic missile called Oreshnik, which Moscow claims cannot be intercepted. The attack resulted in at least 2-4 fatalities and 25-83 injuries, according to varying reports. This is the third time Russia has used the Oreshnik hypersonic missile in an attack on Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed the use of the powerful missile in the attack. The Oreshnik missile is an experimental intermediate-range hypersonic ballistic missile, and its deployment marks one of the largest attacks on Kyiv during the ongoing conflict. The Kremlin had been gearing up for the imminent attack, which has caused significant damage and casualties in the Ukrainian capital.

stories.headline: Shark kills spearfisher in front of friends in Australia: "Terrifying thing to see" A spearfisher was killed on the Great Barrier Reef on Sunday in Australia's second fatal shark attack in just over a week, police said.
stories.summary: A spearfisher was killed in a shark attack on the Great Barrier Reef in Australia on Sunday. This incident marks the country's second fatal shark attack in just over a week, according to police. The victim was with friends on a group spearfishing trip when the attack occurred. Witnesses described the scene as a "terrifying thing to see." The incident is currently being investigated by authorities. The attack resulted in the death of the spearfisher, with details of the incident still emerging. Police have confirmed the fatality, and an investigation is underway to determine the circumstances surrounding the attack. The Great Barrier Reef is a popular destination for water activities, and this incident serves as a reminder of the risks associated with interacting with marine wildlife.

stories.headline: NECA Reacts To ICJ Ruling On Right To Strike The Nigeria Employers’ Consultative Association (NECA) has expressed mixed reactions to a recent International Court of Justice (ICJ) advisory opinion
stories.summary: The Nigeria Employers' Consultative Association (NECA) has expressed mixed reactions to a recent International Court of Justice (ICJ) advisory opinion on the Right to Strike under ILO Convention No. 87. The ICJ delivered its opinion, which may impact labor laws and industrial harmony in Nigeria. NECA's reaction comes as the organization has been advocating for stronger labor justice systems to promote industrial harmony. The ICJ's advisory opinion may have implications for strike activity, which increased nearly 50% in 2022. The development is being closely watched, particularly in light of an upcoming Supreme Court case that threatens workers' ability to strike. NECA's mixed reaction suggests that the organization is weighing the potential benefits and drawbacks of the ICJ's opinion on the right to strike. The opinion may influence labor laws and practices in Nigeria and other countries.

stories.headline: What Trump Did Instead Of Attending Son's Wedding No surprise here.
stories.summary: Donald Trump did not attend his son Donald Trump Jr's wedding, citing the need to remain in Washington, D.C. at the White House during an important period. The president had previously hinted that he might not attend, describing the wedding as a "small little private affair" and citing a complicated schedule. On Friday, he confirmed that he would not be attending, blaming "circumstances pertaining to Government, and my love for the United States of America." Trump offered his congratulations to the couple, Donald Trump Jr and his bride Bettina, on social media platform Truth Social. The decision was reportedly also made to keep the ceremony private, as sources had told CNN that the president's absence would help maintain the couple's desired level of privacy.

stories.headline: Epic Games' Unreal Engine 6 may include a metaverse launcher for its games
stories.summary: Epic Games' Unreal Engine 6 may feature a metaverse launcher, integrating games like Rocket League, Fortnite, and other partnered titles. A teaser for Rocket League's Unreal Engine 6 overhaul hinted at this possibility, showing a lineup of Epic games, including Lego and Fortnite. Epic has expressed ambitions to develop its take on the metaverse, with Unreal Engine 6 potentially embodying this vision. The company has teased future integrations involving Fortnite, LEGO Fortnite, and other projects tied to its metaverse-style ecosystem. Unreal Engine 5 introduced technologies like Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen global illumination, which have been iterated upon in subsequent releases, focusing on performance optimization and large-scale open-world rendering improvements. The metaverse launcher could be a key feature of Unreal Engine 6, bringing Epic's games together in a unified ecosystem.

stories.headline: Apple Is Reportedly Making AirPods Less Frustrating to Control
stories.summary: Apple is reportedly revamping the AirPods settings menu to make it more functional with the release of iOS 27. The update will also apply to accompanying OS updates for Mac and iPads. According to reports, the new settings menu will improve control over AirPods, making them less frustrating to use. However, AirPods will not be getting a dedicated app like the Apple Watch. The changes are expected to arrive with iOS 27, but other innovations, such as a new pen tool and camera-equipped AirPods, are planned for future releases, including a potential launch in 2027 alongside Apple's rumored smart glasses. The camera-equipped AirPods may have concerns, including reduced battery life and surveillance issues. The updates aim to enhance the overall user experience of AirPods, addressing long-standing frustrations with their control and functionality.

stories.headline: Sony Launches Reon Pocket Pro Plus Wearable Air Conditioner In Time For Summer Heatwaves
stories.summary: Sony has launched the Reon Pocket Pro Plus, a wearable air conditioner designed to be worn under clothing, just in time for summer heatwaves. The new model delivers up to 20% more cooling power than its predecessor, thanks to a new cooling algorithm and redesigned thermal system. A companion app is also available to accompany the device. The Reon Pocket Pro Plus is currently available for purchase in the UK for £199 on Amazon. In the US, it will be sold exclusively through Sony's online store starting summer 2026. A release is also planned for other parts of Europe in summer 2026, with launch news available on Sony's website. The device is designed to provide personal cooling, making it a potential solution for hot summer weather.

stories.headline: 7 Clever Ways To Use Siri In Apple CarPlay
stories.summary: Apple CarPlay users can utilize Siri to control their vehicle's features while minimizing distractions on the road. Following the addition of new features like Apple Sports and ambient music widgets in April 2026, Siri can be used to perform various tasks. To access Siri, drivers can press and hold the voice command button on their steering wheel and ask a question or request an action. Alternatively, they can use their car's built-in controls to control CarPlay. With Siri voice control, users can ask for what they want, making it a convenient and safe way to navigate and access features while driving. This functionality is available in its current form, with a new version of Siri featuring Google Gemini integration expected in the future. Siri can be used to control CarPlay, enhancing the overall driving experience.

stories.headline: Blue Jays' Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Dylan Cease Leave With Injuries The Blue Jays lost first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and right-hander Dylan Cease to injuries on Sunday.
stories.summary: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Dylan Cease of the Toronto Blue Jays left a game with injuries on Sunday. Guerrero Jr., the team's first baseman, suffered a Grade 1 strain of his left oblique and is expected to need about three weeks to recover. The injury occurred during the Blue Jays' loss to the Pirates. Cease, a right-hander, also exited the game due to an undisclosed injury. The Blue Jays have been dealing with injuries throughout the season, and these latest setbacks may impact their lineup and pitching rotation. The team provided updates on the injuries, but further details on Cease's condition are not available. The loss of Guerrero Jr. and potentially Cease may affect the Blue Jays' performance in the coming weeks.

stories.headline: Pep Guardiola reaction: What did Manchester City manager say after farewell game vs Aston Villa? For the final time as Manchester City manager, Pep Guardiola shared his reaction as his said goodbye on an emotional day.
stories.summary: Pep Guardiola managed his final game as Manchester City manager, an emotional 2-1 loss to Aston Villa. In his farewell, Guardiola reflected on his time at the club, saying "We worked. We suffered. We fought. And we did things our own way." He emphasized the importance of maintaining high standards after his departure, telling players not to let their standards drop. The match saw Ollie Watkins score twice for Aston Villa, spoiling Guardiola's final game. Despite the loss, the occasion marked the end of a highly successful era under Guardiola's leadership. The manager's emotional goodbye was a testament to his dedication and impact on the club during his tenure. Guardiola's farewell speech highlighted the team's achievements and his pride in their unique approach to the game.

stories.headline: Martinius Stenshorne takes first Formula 2 victory in Rodin Motorsport 1-2 Martinius Stenshorne kept his cool in a dramatic Montreal Feature Race to earn his maiden victory in FIA Formula 2.
stories.summary: Martinius Stenshorne secured his first FIA Formula 2 victory in the Montreal Feature Race, leading a Rodin Motorsport 1-2 finish. He kept his cool in a dramatic and chaotic race, which was affected by rain. Stenshorne edged out his teammate Alexander Dunne, who finished second. The eventful afternoon in Canada saw the race conclude under safety car conditions. This marked Stenshorne's maiden win in the FIA Formula 2 Championship, a significant achievement for the driver and Rodin Motorsport. The victory came as part of the Canadian Grand Prix weekend, with Stenshorne demonstrating his skills in challenging conditions to take the top step of the podium.

stories.headline: Carrick says Man Utd's third-place finish 'something to build on' Fernandes set a new outright Premier League record of 21 assists in a single season by providing the corner from which Dorgu headed in to give United a 1-0 lead
stories.summary: Manchester United finished the 2025/26 Premier League season in third place under Michael Carrick. The team concluded the campaign with a strong performance, including a 3-0 victory over Brighton. Bruno Fernandes set a new Premier League record with 21 assists in a single season, providing a corner that led to a goal against Brighton. Fernandes' record-breaking assist helped United secure a 1-0 lead. The team's third-place finish was confirmed after a 3-2 win over Nottingham Forest. Carrick praised his players for a strong finish to the season, considering it a foundation for future success. The third-place finish and Fernandes' record-breaking achievement are seen as positive outcomes for the club. Carrick's leadership and the team's performance have provided a solid base for the upcoming season.

stories.headline: Massive outrage in J&K over alleged rape-murder of minor girl in Budgam; SIT formed to probe incident
stories.summary: A 12-year-old girl from Budgam district in Jammu and Kashmir was found raped and murdered in a nearby field. The girl had gone missing on Saturday evening and her body was discovered 200 meters from her house on Sunday morning. The police have formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) under the supervision of DySP Headquarters Budgam Sajad Ahmad to probe the incident. Preliminary findings suggest rape and murder, prompting widespread outrage in the region. The National Conference chief spokesperson, Tanvir Sadiq, has expressed condolences to the bereaved family and demanded a thorough, impartial, and time-bound investigation. The SIT is tasked with probing every possible angle to establish the truth and ensure accountability. The incident has sparked massive outrage in J&K, with many calling for justice for the victim and her family.

stories.headline: I wasn’t allowed to see her body, mother of murdered girl alleges
stories.summary: A 10-year-old girl's body was found near Coimbatore, India, on May 22, 2026, after being sexually assaulted and murdered. The mother alleged that her husband took the child's body to his native place in Salem and cremated it without her consent or allowing her to see the body. The incident occurred near the Kannampalayam tank in Coimbatore district. The mother made the allegations on May 24, 2026. The case is being investigated, and no further details have been released about the husband or any potential suspects. The incident has drawn attention to similar cases of murder and disappearance, including those of Joleen Cummings and Alicia Tverberg, whose bodies were either never found or discovered under tragic circumstances. The investigation into the 10-year-old girl's death is ongoing.

stories.headline: Dowry case: 12 days after her death and second autopsy, Twisha Sharma cremated in Bhopal
stories.summary: Twisha Sharma, a former model and actor, was cremated in Bhopal on May 24, 12 days after her death on May 12. Her death allegedly resulted from dowry harassment at her marital home. A second autopsy was conducted by a team of doctors from AIIMS Delhi, after which her body was handed over to her family. The cremation took place at Bhopal's Bhadbhada Vishram Ghat, with her brother, Major Harshit Sharma, lighting the funeral pyre. The second postmortem was part of the ongoing investigation into her case. The family had waited 12 days for the completion of the autopsy and other formalities before performing the last rites. The case is being investigated as a dowry harassment incident, with further proceedings expected to follow.

stories.headline: ‘Love India’: Trump joins US’ 250th Independence Day celebration in Delhi via call, praises PM Modi
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump virtually addressed the US Embassy's 250th Independence Day celebration in New Delhi, praising Prime Minister Narendra Modi and expressing his affection for India. During the call, Trump referred to PM Modi as a "friend" and stated he is a "big fan" of the Indian leader. The event was part of Secretary of State Marco Rubio's four-day visit to India. Trump's virtual address reaffirmed strong India-US ties, with the US President saying he "loves India." The celebration marked the 250th anniversary of US Independence, with Trump participating as a special guest. The US President's remarks highlighted the close relationship between the two nations and their leaders. The event was held in Delhi and attended by dignitaries, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who dialed Trump for the virtual address.

stories.headline: US and China engage in high-stakes diplomatic talks to ease tensions over Taiwan
stories.summary: The US and China are engaging in high-stakes diplomatic talks to ease tensions over Taiwan. Chinese President Xi Jinping has reiterated that Taiwan is part of China, warning the US to exercise caution in arms dealings with Taiwan. The US has a One China policy, but has also been considering a major arms package for Taiwan. Recently, US President Donald Trump visited Beijing and held talks with Xi Jinping, amid increased tensions between the two nations. The talks aim to lower tensions and find a resolution to the Taiwan issue, which has been a point of contention between the US and China. The US has not made a decision on the arms package, and Washington has been advised not to move away from the One China policy to avoid increasing the risk of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan.

stories.headline: NATO leaders gather for emergency meeting to discuss rising threats from Russia
stories.summary: NATO leaders gathered for an emergency meeting on October 14, 2025, to discuss rising threats from Russia and address the alliance's response to emerging threats and defense priorities. The meeting signals NATO's urgent response to new security challenges. This comes after NATO leaders unanimously condemned Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, deemed the gravest threat. The alliance has been addressing threats from Russia, as well as Iran and China, in recent summits. The emergency meeting is a demonstration of NATO's commitment to defending its members against growing security concerns. The situation is complex, with other nations, including the US, posing potential threats to regional stability, as seen in recent developments regarding Greenland, where Canada and Nordic nations formed a military alliance to defend against potential US capture.

stories.headline: India and the US announce major partnership to counterbalance Chinese influence in the Indo-Pacific region
stories.summary: India and the US have announced a major partnership to counterbalance Chinese influence in the Indo-Pacific region. The collaboration aims to address regional challenges and bolster defense through multiple military exercises, ensuring regional security. The partnership focuses on reinforcing supply chains, connectivity, and technology collaboration to counterbalance China's economic influence. India prioritizes the Indian Ocean, while its Quad partners, including the US, Australia, and Japan, focus on the Pacific, particularly the South China Sea and East China Sea. The US and India have displayed increasing harmony in their bilateral relationship, driven by concerns over containing China's rise. The partnership is part of a broader effort to balance against China's growing influence in the region, with India and the US playing crucial roles in maintaining regional stability and security. This cooperation marks a significant development in the Indo-Pacific region.

stories.headline: European Union imposes strict sanctions on Russia in response to escalating aggression in Ukraine
stories.summary: The European Union has imposed strict sanctions on Russia in response to its escalating aggression in Ukraine. The 20th package of sanctions aims to maximize pressure on Russia and end its war of aggression against Ukraine. The measures, which will apply until September 15, 2026, are designed to limit Russia's ability to finance its war efforts. The EU has also adopted sanctions against Belarus, Iran, and North Korea for their support of Russia's military aggression against Ukraine. The sanctions remain in place due to Russia's ongoing aggression, with the EU continuing to ramp up pressure to achieve its policy objective of ending the war. The EU's actions are part of a broader effort to hold Russia accountable for its actions in Ukraine. The sanctions are subject to periodic review and extension.

stories.headline: Sensex jumps 800 points: Why is stock market rising today? Indian stock markets opened sharply higher on Monday as lower crude prices and a firmer rupee lifted sentiment.
stories.summary: Indian stock markets opened sharply higher on Monday, with the Sensex jumping 800 points and the Nifty rising over 1 percent. The rally was led by information technology stocks, including Infosys and TCS, which saw broad-based buying. Infosys rose 4.48% to Rs 1,288.10, while TCS gained 3.50% to Rs 2,475.50. The surge was driven by lower crude prices and a firmer rupee, which lifted investor sentiment. The market capitalization of BSE-listed companies increased by over Rs 3 lakh crore. The BSE Midcap and Smallcap indices also rose, contributing to the overall gain. This rebound follows recent volatility in the Indian stock market, influenced by uncertainty over the US economy and mixed earnings, with the Sensex previously rebounding over 900 points on May 23.

stories.headline: Sensex jumps 850 points, Nifty nears 24,000 on US-Iran peace deal hopes.
stories.summary: Indian stock markets surged on Monday, with the Sensex jumping over 850 points and the Nifty nearing 24,000. The rally was fueled by rising hopes for a US-Iran peace deal and falling oil prices. Broad-based buying across sectors such as banking, auto, and oil & gas supported the surge. The Sensex gained over 1% and the Nifty also rose by around 1%. The increase in investor sentiment was driven by easing crude oil prices and renewed optimism around a possible Iran-US peace deal. As a result, the Sensex and Nifty indices traded sharply higher, with the Sensex crossing the 23,950 mark in early trade. The market rally was driven by five key factors, including the potential peace deal and declining oil prices.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today Live, May 25: Stock to buy today: Saregama India (₹402.70) Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is being closely watched, with the Nifty 50 nearing a strong resistance level of 25,150. Investors are advised to trade cautiously. Meanwhile, Saregama India's stock has been identified as a potential buy, currently trading at ₹402.70. The stock had been moving sideways between ₹315 and ₹370 since the start of the year but recently broke out of this range. The Sensex and Nifty 50 are being monitored for updates, with live equity market watches and share market live charts available. Market trends and research reports are also being analyzed to provide insights into the current market situation. The Bank Nifty is also under observation, with business news and share market live updates being provided to keep investors informed.

stories.headline: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday Indian equity benchmarks closed modestly higher on Friday, with financial stocks leading the gains.
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed modestly higher on Friday, led by gains in financial stocks. The Nifty and Sensex edged up, while pharma and other sectors saw mixed results. This week, markets will focus on key reports, including the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) and major tech and streaming earnings. Investors will also watch US-related news for cues. Additionally, stocks like Motilal Oswal, BSE, and Bombay Stock Exchange have seen significant gains in trade. The "Magnificent Seven" stocks were mostly trading lower in premarket sessions on Monday, following record highs on Friday. Market expert Nilesh Shah notes that stock performance often reflects expectations rather than reality, and investors should watch for earnings and other key factors to drive market action on Monday. These factors will decide the stock market's direction ahead.

stories.headline: Australians increasingly staying put when it comes to jobs and housing, economic data suggests
stories.summary: Australians are becoming less mobile and more risk-averse, with economic data indicating a decrease in job and housing changes. People are also less likely to start new businesses or move to different states. This trend is reflected in various economic indicators, suggesting a shift towards stability and security. Business strategist Kate McCready attributes this to fear in the workplace. The data shows a decline in dynamic behavior, with individuals opting for familiarity over new opportunities. This change in behavior has significant implications for the economy, as reduced mobility and risk-taking can impact innovation and growth. The trend is observed across various sectors, with Australians prioritizing stability over exploration and entrepreneurship.

stories.headline: Oil Price Shock Clouds Ghana's Strong Economic Recovery
stories.summary: Ghana's strong economic recovery is being threatened by a surge in crude oil prices due to tensions around the Strait of Hormuz. The country's Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) slipped to 50.3 in April from 51.4 in March, indicating a slower pace of business expansion. Companies are absorbing higher costs, affecting business and consumer confidence. Despite a 5.8% economic expansion in recent times, driven by non-oil growth and gold exports, rising oil prices pose a challenge. Ghana's non-oil GDP growth rate has shown resilience, but the current oil price shock may impact the country's economic stability. The surge in oil prices is weighing on the economy, potentially clouding Ghana's strong recovery.

stories.headline: X Is Cracking Down on Content Thieves
stories.summary: X is cracking down on content thieves by reallocating impressions from reposts to the original creators. The platform has identified large accounts that programmatically reupload content to game the revenue system. Impressions from reuploaded posts will now be allocated entirely to the original creators. This move aims to prevent aggregators from profiting off others' work. Additionally, X has accepted new commitments from the British online safety regulator Ofcom to better protect UK users from seeing illegal hate and terror content on the platform. The crackdown targets accounts that reupload content without remorse, including plagiarized skits and shameless reuploads, to ensure original creators receive the revenue they deserve. This change is part of X's efforts to promote a fair and safe online environment.

stories.headline: Premium SUV buyers are turning towards EVs like Zeekr 7X
stories.summary: Premium SUV buyers are increasingly turning to electric vehicles, with the Tesla Model Y and Zeekr 7X being clear favorites. The majority of sales in the premium mid-size SUV segment are now electric vehicles. Zeekr has begun pre-sales of its updated 7X SUV, with a launch set for October 28. The company has also launched the Zeekr 9X full-size SUV in China, receiving over 10,000 firm orders. The shift towards electric vehicles is evident, with other companies like Xpeng planning to launch extended-range electric vehicles in 2026. The Zeekr 7X has been praised for delivering both performance and luxury, making it a top choice in the premium SUV segment. As the electric vehicle market continues to evolve, Zeekr and other companies are poised to meet the growing demand for premium electric SUVs.
